title: Jesus... My Family Loves Me But Doesn't Understand Me. 💔
topic: she loves her family but they cannot read what she is carrying, so she gives Amma half the story and feels loneliest at home

bible.text: For whosoever shall do the will of my Father which is in heaven, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Jesus... my family loves me, but they don't understand me. 💔

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: Amma asks why I'm quiet lately. I keep giving her half the story.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: She raised you. Some weights you hide to protect her, not to deceive her.

lines.speaker: person
lines.text: But hiding it all is lonely. Even a full house can feel empty.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: Then let Me fill the room you don't show anyone. I understand you fully.

lines.speaker: jesus
lines.text: You're not unloved at that table. You're just known best somewhere else.

lines.speaker: engagement
lines.text: Send this to the one giving their family half the story. 💔
